label: The Thread
description: Brought across from a page made elsewhere; every word, picture and link is a field.

paragraphs.text: The Thread is a personalized mentorship for meeting the chapter you are actually living. There is no single curriculum for becoming.

We begin with what is alive: where you are, what is changing, what is asking for attention, what you long for, what you are becoming. From there, I draw from the arts and practices I have spent my life studying and living to shape a journey around you.

lines.lines: Creative practice. Ritual. Pattern tracking. Life design.
